title: Permit keys (connector protocol 2.0, draft)
description: The Brain's answer to GET /secured/connector/v2/permit-keys, over Link's mTLS channel only: the public keys Link verifies permits with. Link pins them; it accepts a new key only from this route, and never from the Platform or a job. A key verifies a permit only when the permit's iat lies in its window (not_before <= iat < not_after), checked at the permit's iat and not at Link's clock, so a repeat delivered after a key's not_after still gets its first result (SPEC-write-back-10). Closed.

public_key.description: The 32-byte Ed25519 public key, base64url without padding.
